description:
Configure Wireshark to display TCP latency metrics and isolate the worst connection.

1. Open the capture file `~/Documents/captures/200722_tcp_anon.pcapng`.
2. Add a custom column titled "Stream" showing the TCP Stream Index (`tcp.stream`).
3. Add a custom column titled "RTT" showing the TCP Round Trip Time (`tcp.analysis.ack_rtt`).
4. Sort by the new RTT column to identify the packet with the highest latency (highest RTT value).
5. Create a report file at `~/Documents/captures/latency_report.txt` containing the details of this packet in the following format:
   max_rtt_packet_number: <Packet Number>
   max_rtt_value_seconds: <RTT Value>
   bad_stream_index: <Stream Index>
6. Filter or follow the stream for this worst packet and export ONLY that TCP stream to a new file named `~/Documents/captures/slow_stream.pcapng`.
